newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Sugar content 13.6 pct in 3rd Ukraine beet test.
newsitem.headline: Sugar content 13.6 pct in 3rd Ukraine beet test.

text.p: The third Ukrainian sugar beet test showed an average sugar content of 13.6 percent, down from 14.3 percent in the third test in 1995, Valentyn Tymoshenko, a senior Agriculture Ministry official, said on Tuesday.
The ministry gave the following data-
Ukraine's government is forecasting a beet harvest of 26 million tonnes this year, compared to 30 million in 1995.
Vice Prime Minister Mykhailo Zubets at a recent news conference complained of drought conditions which affected all crops.
The state sugar concern Ukrtsukor sees this year total Ukrainian refined sugar production at 2.6 million tonnes, down from last year's 3.485 million.

Earlier this month government officials said the country would export no more than one million tonnes of refined sugar from its current 1996 harvest, compared to forecast exports of two million tonnes throughout this year.
Ukraine planted 1.390 million hectares to beet this year, compared with 1.406 million in 1995.
